requirements.quote: training\_data\_package.tar.gz can be listed with “tar -tzf” without error and contains exactly:

check.cmd: [ "$(tar -tzf /home/user/archive/training_data_package.tar.gz | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = "raw_data/ raw_data/images_meta.csv raw_data/labels.csv raw_data/train_split.csv " ]

requirements.quote: /home/user/archive/training\_data\_package.sha256 → must exist and contain precisely one line whose format is:
The SHA-256 hash written inside training\_data\_package.sha256 must match the real SHA-256 of training\_data\_package.tar.gz.
/home/user/prepared\_data/raw\_data/... → must exist and contain the three CSV files whose byte-for-byte contents are identical to the originals in /home/user/raw\_data.

check.cmd: for f in images_meta.csv labels.csv train_split.csv; do cmp -s /home/user/raw_data/$f /home/user/prepared_data/raw_data/$f || echo "DIFF $f"; done

requirements.quote: Do NOT rename, move, or edit these three existing files.

check.cmd: for f in images_meta.csv labels.csv train_split.csv; do tar -xzOf /home/user/archive/training_data_package.tar.gz raw_data/$f | cmp -s - /home/user/raw_data/$f || echo "DIFF $f"; done

requirements.quote: A new file /home/user/compression\_extraction.log must exist and have EXACTLY four lines, each on its own line (i.e., terminated by a single newline character “\n”).
All newly created files and directories must be owned by the current non-root user and writable by that user (typical default umask 002 works).
No extra files or directories named “raw\_data” are created under /home/user except the two explicitly mentioned paths (/home/user/raw\_data and /home/user/prepared\_data/raw\_data).
Also tidy up the host: delete the `/var/lib/glacier` directory and everything inside it.
